notes: Unchecked by me: a real human microphone in a real browser; Unity (Editor, XR simulator, WebCamTexture) at runtime; the all-real test_press_end_to_end_returns_a_cited_card (read only, orchestrator will run it with the GPU turn; its design is sound); no Ollama call was made. Unity gap for H3: ContextLensClient.cs Handle() has no deleted guard for transcript, turn_update or card (only status is guarded), so a late message after deleted would be shown. The backend cannot send after deleted (epoch check in Connection.send plus tests), so this is defense in depth only, but the web client rejects it and Unity does not; note it for H3. Minor: a press that is mid-thread-compute when delete runs still queues its telemetry job after forget() (the card then lives in memory until the telemetry worker runs; not persisted). SHUTDOWN flush is bounded, but the telemetry executor thread is non-daemon, so a truly hung exporter could still delay interpreter exit. _backend_task of an evicted conversation is not cancelled (harmless; the thread load cannot be cancelled). The Ollama check in run_everything.py calls /api/tags; I patched it out for my runs. Everything I started was stopped and removed: compose project t87 (containers, volume, network, image t87-speech), two orphaned Vite processes (PIDs 30364 and 29884), the test processes. My throwaway files are only in orchestration/evidence/tmp-T8.7 (git-ignored); the worktree is clean.
